policy: Rule semantics may be harmonized to a Benchmark category, but test IDs and expected labels must never be used in a mapping.

java.lang.security.audit.crypto.des-is-d.rationale: The rule detects use of DES. Semgrep classifies the weakness as CWE-326, while OWASP Benchmark v1.2 classifies its broken/risky symmetric-crypto cases as CWE-327.

java.lang.security.audit.crypto.desede-i.rationale: The rule detects use of 3DES/DESede. Semgrep classifies the weakness as CWE-326, while OWASP Benchmark v1.2 classifies its broken/risky symmetric-crypto cases as CWE-327.
